title: Buttered Risotto with Honeyed Ukrainian Twist
description: A creamy risotto dish with a sweet and savory flavor combination inspired by Ukrainian cuisine. This buttered risotto recipe adds a touch of honeyed goodness.
instructions: Heat the buttered oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Ukrainian dried herbs and cook for 1 minute.
Add the risotto and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add 1 cup of warm water and stir until absorbed. Repeat this process until the risotto is cooked.
Stir in the honeyed balsamic vinegar.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
